$comment: How much a change can hurt, by what it touches. Radar labels every PR from it (impact:low|normal|high|critical), Iris sets the final label, and Scout sizes its testing by it. The highest matching tier wins. Patterns are globs (** any depth, * one segment) or, with "keyword", a case-insensitive word in the path. Rules marked generic are broad catch-alls that the low tier may override. Make the globs match this repo.

critical.why: Decides who gets in, moves money, or holds secrets

high.why: What every page depends on: the API, the data's shape, shared code

low.why: Tests, docs, the crew's own setup and tooling
